task: Align charts/nfs-quota-agent Chart.yaml version and appVersion to 0.4.0 ahead of the v0.4.0 tag so the release-preflight guard (#130) passes (part of #26)

events.summary: User instruction: set Chart.yaml version and appVersion to 0.4.0 and prepare the release. Codex release pre-flight (PR #130) had flagged that a v0.4.0 tag with Chart version 0.4.1 / appVersion 0.3.0 would publish a mismatched chart; the fail-closed guard now blocks that.
events.provenance: user request 2026-09-03 and the Codex release pre-flight report behind PR #130

events.summary: Only Chart.yaml version/appVersion change. CHANGELOG.md is generated by git-cliff on tag (release.yaml changelog/update-changelog jobs) and is not edited. Chart 0.4.0/0.4.1 were never published (last release v0.3.0; no gh-pages index), so moving version 0.4.1 -> 0.4.0 does not collide with a published artifact. No template, values, RBAC or code change.
runtime: `make release-preflight TAG=v0.4.0` on origin/main failed: "chart version=0.4.1 / chart appVersion=0.3.0 ... must all match" (exit 2).

Set version: 0.4.0 and appVersion: "0.4.0" in charts/nfs-quota-agent/Chart.yaml. Default `helm template` now renders image ghcr.io/dasomel/nfs-quota-agent:0.4.0 and helm.sh/chart: nfs-quota-agent-0.4.0.

`make release-preflight TAG=v0.4.0` exits 0 after the change; `helm lint charts/nfs-quota-agent` clean; `helm template` default renders the 0.4.0 image tag and chart label; trace evaluated with evaluate.py and gated against baseline.eval.json.
events.scope: Chart metadata, release-preflight guard, helm lint/render, behavior-contract trace validation. The release workflow itself only runs on the v* tag and is not exercised here.

events.summary: Chart.yaml is aligned to 0.4.0; the v0.4.0 tag will pass the release-preflight guard. Unverified: the tag-triggered release jobs (image push, binaries, manifest v4, bundle, chart) have not run; that happens when the maintainer pushes the tag.
Release preparation change complete and verified locally; tagging is a separate maintainer action.
